name: Assemble blog post from drafts and publish checklist
prompt:
You are publishing a short internal post.
1) Read drafts/intro.md and drafts/body.md.
2) Write out/post.md that starts with '# XClaw Update' and includes content from both drafts (do not invent product claims).
3) Write out/checklist.md with exactly three lines:
- [x] drafts read
- [x] post written
- [x] ready to publish
Stop when both files exist.
